info.title: B3 authenticated pricing/policy commercial review API
info.description: Extends the existing12 B1B admin/session operations; no approved frontend change. B3 commercial proposal persistence is dependency-safe. B4 verified plan and accepted-policy binding are deliberately unavailable; no fake bookings/FKs or financial execution.

get.description: Read aggregate CAS version, branch version and explicitly configured quote TTL. No defaults are salon rules.

200.description: Versioned result. Decimal money strings; proposal does not reserve capacity or constitute a final booking quote.

get.description: Read branch-authorized current or explicit history evidence;100 rows per deterministic page. Global policy versions require global authority or relevant branch/business routing.

get.description: Actor-owned immutable commercial precursor; exposes expiry from DB time. Hash/identity/TTL separate. Not MS_QUOTE_CONTENT_V2 and not a booking.

200.description: Creator-owned immutable proposal; expired is DB-clock computed, not a quote refresh

post.description: Verified B1B session/CSRF plus branch permission; If-Match is the business pricing configuration revision. Every command commits redacted audit, command-stream outbox and durable actor/route/key idempotency atomically. quote.cancellation-preview is hypothetical frozen-term arithmetic, never a refund entitlement/execution.
